notes.title: The Farm - 0.7.1.3 Update
notes.notes:
Dear,
We will guide you through the problems and fixes that occurred up to the day before.


Update contents guide
Version: 0.7.1.3
 - The time of day in the in-game has increased slightly.
   Balance adjustments will be made continuously.
 - Fixed a problem where the text is displayed incorrectly even though the mini game fails.
 - Japanese in-game text has been corrected.

Development status and update plan information

 - There may be problems with translation in some languages.
   We are trying to make the translation as natural as possible, but there may be areas that are insufficient.
   If there is a sentence or word that is not smooth, please report it and we will correct it.

 - We are currently working on improving the graphics.
   If possible, we will try to improve it in a way that does not spoil the current graphic atmosphere.
   After the update, users can select and use the improved graphics through in-game settings.
   This is a time-consuming operation and will not be updated in a short time.
   We will share graphic resources that will be improved in the near future.

 - The work to reinforce the content after entering the infinite mode is in progress.
   This development work will be released and applied in stages, and will be continued.
   Fragmentally, a small map can be added to do something.
   First, as soon as the content to be released is completed, we will share it on the community hub page.


Thank you to all users who play.
